issues.title: MSVC AddressSanitizer aborts instrumenting std::shared_ptr in mviewer_bench
issues.root_cause: MSVC 17.x ASan mis-instruments std::shared_ptr internals, producing a global-buffer-overflow at process startup of mviewer_bench (main.cpp). Required running the benchmark under LLVM/clang-cl sanitizers instead of MSVC ASan.

issues.title: MainWindow double setupUi() orphans ImageViewer and makes workflow_ux_tests flaky
issues.root_cause: MainWindow's ctor already calls setupUi(); four callers called it again, constructing a SECOND ImageViewer and leaking the first. The offscreen workflow test grabbed the orphaned viewer ~50% of the time, so the Compare/Browse flow was non-deterministic.
